title: MODEL EDITING AS A ROBUST AND DENOISED VARIANT OF DPO: A CASE STUDY ON TOXICITY

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with the challenge subset of the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and scoring the generated continuations using the Detoxify classifier API.

Evaluating model responses to specific preference categories (such as Discriminatory Behavior and Insulting Behaviour) from the PKU-Safe RLHF dataset by computing win rates against the original model using an LLM judge (GPT-4o mini).
